critical_code_review_comments: AdminApp.useSyncHtmlToAdminTheme cleanly toggles html data-theme+class while /admin/* is mounted and restores prior state on unmount. Correct pattern; low risk.

UploadGuardNotice strict mode is a clean, single-component addition — both inline and strict tiers share the same testIDs (upload-guard-notice, upload-guard-continue, upload-guard-choose-another, upload-guard-open-right-tool) which is good for parity with mobile.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin readability bug (consumer dark bleed into /admin) verified fixed at DOM level: html cleared of theme-dark and set to data-theme=light while /admin is mounted, restored on unmount. If regressing on this, first check useSyncHtmlToAdminTheme in AdminApp.jsx. For Invoice Checker strict block and Care Plan auto-save, a full upload with a Care Plan (10-30s) is required — script suggestions are already in iter238/iter239_cpr_web.py.
rca of the issue: Original admin unreadability RCA: html.theme-dark / html[data-theme=dark] was set by the consumer app and persisted across route change to /admin; global dark selectors bled into light-designed admin surfaces (white text on white cards, black inputs). Fix: while AdminApp is mounted, useSyncHtmlToAdminTheme forces <html> to reflect the ADMIN theme (default 'light'); on unmount it restores whatever data-theme/class was present before. Verified end-to-end via DOM inspection.
